sources.title: Columbia University Disease–Symptom Knowledge Database
sources.role: general disease–symptom association ranking only; not Ayurveda-specific and not patient-level training data

sources.note: Download scripts try the current impact.dbmi.columbia.edu host and the legacy people.dbmi.columbia.edu host. The parser validates expected disease/symptom columns.
